title: Vapetasia – Strawberry Parfait 100ml
description:
Vapetasia – Strawberry Parfait 100ml
Vapetasia
An enchanting mix of vanilla and custard, reaching a perfect harmony of sweet and savory now in a chubby gorilla bottle!
Parfait Strawberry delivers the deliciousness of fresh cut strawberries and honey granola clusters layered with sweet and creamy yogurt. A smooth whole-milk yogurt is whipped with vanilla to provide the perfectly balanced mellow creamy flavor. From that base it delicately got layered with granola clusters kissed with honey and fresh cut strawberries burst with juicy goodness. Bottled and ready to tantalize your taste buds, this gourmet vape is perfect at breakfast or while snacking on the go, it’s delicious any time of the day.
